basic_info.main_problem: 我一直感觉自己在制造汽车方面正在失去天赋，因为上一辆车卖得not快，这导致Self-doubt和Anxiety。
basic_info.core_demands: 我决定寻求咨询，因为这些Self-doubt影响了我的工作表现和整体幸福感。
growth_experiences: 约一个月前，上一辆车的销售比Anticipation慢，来访者据此产生“自己正在失去天赋”的认知；之后在工作场景中，看到同事的车卖得更快会加剧Self-doubt与Anxiety；因压力（截止日期与财务压力）与持续反刍，出现工作Decreased drive、与同事疏远、食欲与Sleep affected。

Last year, designed a car that sold quickly and was well received; at that time the client, by devoting effort to the design and absorbing earlier customer feedback, achieved success, and this experience for a time strengthened confidence and a sense of accomplishment.

core_beliefs: 我have not同事那么有才华
